title: Squanto unites three rival tribes
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Squanto unites three rival tribes, about 17th century at Massachusetts, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh Squanto unites creates this federation of these three tribes that were all rivals against each other

plain: A researcher, Luke Caverns, speaking on a podcast with host Jesse Michels, tells of Squanto, a Native American man in Massachusetts. Caverns says Squanto brought together three tribes that had been rivals and formed them into a single alliance. He tells it as part of a wider look at hidden or overlooked history.
